tools.name: check_base_token
tools.description: Pre-trade risk verdict for a Base ERC-20 (built for brand-new Clanker/Zora/Uniswap v4 launches): simulated buy+sell (honeypot, taxes, round-trip loss), owner powers (mint/blacklist/pause/fee setters, upgradeable proxy), exit liquidity and LP lock, token age and creator history. Returns SAFE/CAUTION/

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Free. Whether an address on Base mainnet is a contract and an ERC-20, plus its name, symbol, decimals and total supply. No risk analysis: use check_base_token (paid) for the SAFE/CAUTION/DANGER verdict.

tools.name: get_sample_verdict
tools.description: Free. A cached example of the check_base_token response for a real Base token, to see the shape before paying.

tools.name: explain_verdict_fields
tools.description: Free. What SAFE/CAUTION/DANGER, the score and each field of a verdict mean, the limits of the checks, prices, and the JSON schema.
